changelog: Phone: the volume is normalized like YouTube in a browser: loud videos are turned down and the rest play at full volume. Before, the TV method (half volume plus a system booster) made videos sound quieter than in the browser.
Phone: "Add to Watch later" is now one tap in the long press menu (no longer buried in "Add to playlist").

The "Add to Watch later" button becomes "Remove from Watch later" on videos of the Watch later list (the video leaves the list at once), and a message confirms the change. Phone and TV (the button is optional on TV).
A playlist (e.g. Watch later) played from its list could switch to unrelated videos (YouTube autoplay) after a couple of videos: the list could be released from memory while it played. Phone and TV.
